items.detail: ★ 原文重點：來文機關為國際半導體產業協會（SEMI），公告主旨為「敬邀貴校師生參與『Chip the Future Challenge』全球學生競賽，並請協助轉知相關系所，鼓勵教師推薦學生參與，拓展半導體人才之國際交流與產業連結」，登載日期 115/10/08，活動詳情在附件。　★ 為什麼這封在今天的 11 封裡被我放在第二位：你是化工系，而**化工在半導體供應鏈裡的位置非常明確** —— 製程化學品、光阻、CMP 漿料、濕蝕刻、先進封裝的材料端，全部是化工本科。SEMI 是半導體設備與材料的全球產業協會（不是學術單位），它辦的學生競賽等於直接對接產業窗口，這種 credential 在找實習與推甄時的分量和一般校內競賽完全不同。　★ 和市場面的連結（這也是今天股市區的主題）：10/08 台股重挫 492 點、奇鋐因調查局搜索跌 105 元、美股 10/09 由 SpaceX 搶頻譜重新定義電信業 —— AI 基建的錢正在從「誰買 GPU」往上游的材料與零組件移動。SEMI 這條線剛好是那個上游。　★ 時間建議：報名或許要交作品或提案，**真正要動手一定是 10/21 期中考之後**。今天只要做一件事：打開附件、抄下截止日、確認期中考後還來得及。

items.en: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
items.zh: 南非法學家 Navi Pillay 獲 2026 年諾貝爾和平獎，曾任聯合國人權事務高級專員
items.summary: The Norwegian Nobel Committee named South African jurist Navi Pillay the 2026 Nobel Peace laureate in Oslo on Friday. Pillay is a former UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and served as a judge on the International Criminal Court and the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, where she helped establish rape as a form of genocide in international law. She more recently chaired a UN commission of inquiry into Gaza. Her legal career began under apartheid, when she became the first non-white woman to open a law practice in her South African province, making the award resonate strongly at home.

items.en: Houthi drones and missiles hit Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, killing three
items.zh: 胡塞武裝襲擊利雅德哈立德國王國際機場，3 死、數百航班取消
items.summary: Attacks attributed to Yemen's Houthis struck facilities at King Khalid International Airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh, killing three people including an airline pilot and prompting the reported cancellation of hundreds of flights. The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed three Houthi missile launch platforms in response, and the United Nations condemned the attacks. The strike extends a pattern of hitting civilian aviation infrastructure deep inside Saudi Arabia rather than front-line positions, following a similar attack on Yemen's Aden airport two days earlier, and raises the risk premium on Gulf air and energy logistics.

items.en: Trump rules out a strike on Iran before the November midterms as explosions are reported near Hormuz
items.zh: 川普表態期中選舉前不攻擊伊朗，荷姆茲海峽附近傳出劇烈爆炸
items.summary: President Donald Trump said the United States would not attack Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, citing what he called productive discussions with Tehran, though the Pentagon is reported to still be examining options including an intensive strike campaign. Washington separately sanctioned vessels tied to Iran's oil trade. The statement helped ease oil prices on Friday even as heavy explosions were reported near the Strait of Hormuz, with Iranian state media suggesting tankers may have struck naval mines, a claim that has not been independently confirmed.

items.en: Student protests continue across France while Spain sees mass housing demonstrations
items.zh: 法國學生抗議持續，西班牙馬德里爆發大規模住房抗議
items.summary: Student-led protests over education funding and police conduct continued in Paris and other French cities, with police reported to have used tear gas near a barricaded Paris high school and organisers pledging to keep going. In Spain, large housing protests filled Madrid after an 87-year-old woman died following her removal from a home she had lived in for decades; activists directed anger at investment funds they describe as vulture funds, and a snap election is reported to be approaching. Both movements centre on cost-of-living and institutional trust rather than party politics.

items.en: WMO warns El Nino could turn exceptionally strong and persist into February 2027
items.zh: 世界氣象組織警告聖嬰現象可能異常強勁並延續到 2027 年 2 月
items.summary: The World Meteorological Organization warned that the current El Nino could become exceptionally strong and persist into February 2027, with implications for flooding, drought and food security across multiple regions. The warning lands alongside two concrete disruptions already visible this week: Indonesian wildfire smoke spreading across Southeast Asia, closing schools in parts of Malaysia and producing Singapore's worst haze of 2026, and flooding in Santiago, Chile, that damaged homes and roads and led the president to declare a state of catastrophe. For Taiwan the near-term relevance is winter rainfall and agricultural prices.

items.en: Google Cloud unveils Gemini Agent, an enterprise agent that works across Gmail, Drive, Docs and Calendar
items.zh: Google Cloud 發表企業版 Gemini Agent，可跨 Gmail、Drive、Docs、Sheets、Slides、Calendar 自主執行任務
items.summary: Google Cloud introduced Gemini Agent on October 8, an enterprise agent for office work that can plan a multi-step task and then act across Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides and Calendar rather than only answering questions. Google is pairing it with identity, permissions and sandboxing controls, which is the part enterprises actually block on. Google also released AI Edge Foresight, an experimental Mac app that transcribes meetings and answers questions fully offline using the on-device EmbeddingGemma 2 model at roughly 740 million parameters, pushing useful agent work onto local hardware.

items.en: Anthropic tightens Claude usage policy and bans sustained cruelty toward the model
items.zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude 使用政策，收緊選舉、武器與監控用途，並禁止持續虐待模型
items.summary: Anthropic updated Claude's usage policies with stricter limits on election interference, weapons development, surveillance applications and certain financial and medical uses. The revision also bans sustained and needlessly abusive or cruel behaviour toward Claude itself, which Anthropic links to its research programme on AI welfare while explicitly not claiming that Claude is conscious or capable of suffering. The clause is unusual among frontier labs because it writes a user-conduct rule into a commercial policy on grounds that are explicitly precautionary rather than evidential, and it will likely be copied or contested.

items.en: OpenAI revenue figures split the market: roughly $50 billion run rate now, $70 billion targeted by year-end
items.zh: OpenAI 營收數字引發混亂：9 月底年化約 500 億美元，公司向投資人目標年底逾 700 億美元
items.summary: The Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualised revenue run rate at about $50 billion at the end of September, below the roughly $70 billion figure that had circulated, and AI stocks fell on Thursday. Bloomberg then reported OpenAI had told investors it expects to reach or exceed $70 billion annualised by the end of 2026, citing 77% total run-rate growth in the third quarter and 107% growth in its enterprise segment, in talks around a new raise of roughly $30 billion. The gap reflects different revenue-counting methods, not lost sales.

items.en: Guardians force a winner-take-all ALDS Game 5 against the White Sox, played tonight in Cleveland
items.zh: 守護者逼出美聯分區第五戰，今晚在克里夫蘭決勝，白襪拚 2005 年後首度闖進聯盟冠軍賽
items.summary: The Cleveland Guardians beat the Chicago White Sox 9-5 in Game 4 to level their American League Division Series at 2-2, forcing a deciding Game 5 in Cleveland on Saturday October 10 at 8 p.m. Eastern. The matchup is an all-AL Central series, and Chicago would reach the Championship Series for the first time since winning the 2005 World Series if it takes the final game. The winner faces the Tampa Bay Rays, who are already waiting in the ALCS after sweeping their own series.

items.en: Rays sweep the Yankees 3-0 as Dodgers and Brewers set up the NLCS
items.zh: 光芒直落三橫掃洋基，道奇與釀酒人確定在國聯冠軍賽碰頭
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays completed a 3-0 sweep of the New York Yankees, closing it out with a 4-3 Game 3 win and eliminating New York in the Division Series. In the National League the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Atlanta Braves 4-1 in Game 4 to take that series 3-1, while the Milwaukee Brewers beat the San Diego Padres 3-1 to advance, setting a Dodgers-Brewers Championship Series. The Yankees' sweep is the headline result, since being eliminated without a single win is rare for a club at that payroll.

items.en: South Korea tests a domestically developed hypersonic missile as North Korea again refuses aid
items.zh: 韓國試射自主研發的極音速飛彈，北韓再次拒絕南方醫療援助
items.summary: Seoul is reported to have tested a domestically developed hypersonic missile, a capability milestone that places South Korea among a small group of states with indigenous hypersonic programmes. North Korea separately rejected medical assistance offered by the South for a second time. The two items together describe the current pattern on the peninsula: technical and military capability advancing on the southern side while any humanitarian or diplomatic channel stays closed, which matters for regional risk pricing even when no incident occurs on a given week.

items.en: Researchers explore how J-Pop listening habits relate to visual memory
items.zh: 研究：聽喜愛的流行音樂（含 J-POP）的習慣與視覺記憶表現有關
items.summary: A study published October 9 examined how habits of listening to favourite pop music, including J-Pop, relate to visual memory performance. The design matters more than the headline: familiarity and personal preference are confounded with how often and in what context a person listens, so the result speaks to listening habits rather than to music itself improving memory. For anyone using J-Pop lyrics as a Japanese-learning tool, the practical read is that repeated exposure to material you actually like is doing work that a neutral drill does not.

items.en: Personality acts as an invisible architect for your career, new research finds
items.zh: 新研究：人格特質像一位「看不見的建築師」，長期塑造一個人的職涯軌跡
items.summary: Research published October 9 describes personality as an invisible architect of career trajectories, shaping which jobs people enter, how long they stay and how far they advance, over timescales long enough that the person rarely attributes the outcome to personality at all. The useful caution is directional: personality predicts career paths partly because it changes the environments people select into, so advice built on a trait label risks reinforcing the selection rather than the capability. For a student choosing between research, industry and teaching tracks, the finding argues for testing environments rather than self-typing.

items.en: The brain replays motor skills during sleep without help from the memory centre
items.zh: 研究：大腦在睡眠中重播運動技能，而且不需要記憶中樞（海馬迴）參與
items.summary: Research published October 8 found that the brain replays newly learned motor skills during sleep without involvement from the hippocampus, the structure normally treated as the gateway for memory consolidation. That dissociation suggests procedural and declarative learning consolidate through separate routes during sleep. The practical implication for exam preparation is narrow but real: the kind of material that benefits most from sleep is not uniform, and skills practised by repetition, including worked calculation problems, appear to consolidate through a pathway that cutting sleep short interrupts directly.

items.en: SpaceX buys a spectrum portfolio for Starlink Mobile and wipes double digits off the US carriers
items.zh: SpaceX 收購頻譜推動 Starlink Mobile，美國電信三雄單日崩跌逾 10%，基站 REIT 反而大漲
items.summary: SpaceX agreed to acquire a spectrum licence portfolio to support a direct-to-phone Starlink Mobile service in the United States, and the market repriced the incumbents immediately. On Friday T-Mobile fell about 12.3%, while Verizon and AT&T each dropped roughly 10.9% intraday, and Communication Services was the weakest S&P 500 sector at -1.62%. Crown Castle rose about 11.3% on the same news, since a satellite-first entrant changes tower economics differently from carrier economics. For the watchlist this is the single most consequential SPCX headline of the week.

items.en: AI chip names sell off Thursday on the OpenAI revenue gap, then rebound Friday
items.zh: AI 晶片股週四因 OpenAI 營收落差重挫、週五反彈，那斯達克 100 單日曾跌 1.4%
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell 1.4% on Thursday October 8 after the roughly $50 billion OpenAI run-rate figure became public, with Nvidia, Oracle and CoreWeave all declining as chip stocks sold off. The move reversed on Friday once Bloomberg reported OpenAI's $70 billion year-end target, with Oracle up about 3.1% and Nvidia and Micron both higher in morning trade. The two sessions together show how tightly the whole AI hardware complex is now priced off one private customer's revenue disclosure, which is a concentration risk rather than a growth story.

items.en: Manus raises over $500 million after Beijing blocks Meta's $2 billion acquisition
items.zh: 中國 AI 代理公司 Manus 在 Meta 約 20 億美元併購案被北京擋下後，募得逾 5 億美元
items.summary: Manus raised more than $500 million led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital after Meta's roughly $2 billion acquisition of the company was cancelled following a block by Chinese authorities, leaving one of the most visible agent startups independent and Chinese-owned. In adjacent agent-economy friction, Amazon blocked Meta's Muse shopping agent for failing to identify itself properly while Shopify allowed purchases through Shop Pay, and China began piloting official identities for AI-generated digital humans in Beijing, a market worth about 48 billion yuan in 2025.

items.en: YOASOBI's Asia 10-city dome and stadium tour 'Chowakusei' opens October 24 in Osaka
items.zh: YOASOBI 亞洲十城巨蛋暨體育場巡迴《超惑星》10/24 大阪京瓷巨蛋開跑，5 個亞洲城市尚未公布
items.summary: YOASOBI's ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027, titled Chowakusei, opens on October 24 and 25 at Kyocera Dome Osaka. The Japan leg continues at Vantelin Dome Nagoya on November 7-8, Daiwa House Premist Dome in Hokkaido on November 14-15, PayPay Dome Fukuoka on November 28-29 and Tokyo Dome on December 5-6. The run is billed as the first Asian dome-and-stadium tour on this scale by a Japanese act, split five cities in Japan and five elsewhere in Asia. The five Asian cities are still unannounced, so Taipei and Hong Kong remain open.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Ringo Jam tour 'SHADOWS' runs through October with no overseas dates
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 粉絲俱樂部巡迴《SHADOWS》十月持續進行，10/14–15 千葉、10/23–24 北海道、10/28–29 東京，無海外場
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Ringo Jam fan-club tour SHADOWS continues through October 2026, with dates in Kagawa on October 1, Hiroshima on October 6 and 7, Chiba on October 14 and 15, Hokkaido on October 23 and 24, and Tokyo on October 28 and 29. The band's official schedule lists no overseas dates, so this remains a Japan-domestic, fan-club-priority run following the September 30 release of their sixth album POPS. For anyone in Taiwan or Hong Kong, the arena tour rather than this fan-club series is the one to watch for regional dates.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu announces a six-city national live tour for next year with a new single
items.zh: 米津玄師宣布明年舉辦全國六城市巡迴，新單曲附最速預購序號
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu announced a national live tour covering six cities to be held next year, with a priority-application serial number bundled into his new single. Yonezu tours comparatively rarely and at large scale, so a six-city announcement typically means arena or dome-class venues and a single lottery round that sells out before any general sale. For overseas fans the relevant detail is that his recent tours have not consistently included Taiwan or Hong Kong stops, so the Japan lottery via the single is usually the only reliable route in.

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 Asia leg has already finished, including Taipei Arena
items.zh: King Gnu「CEN+RAL Tour 2026」亞洲場已結束，台北小巨蛋 6/6–6/7 場次已過，香港、曼谷、上海、首爾同列
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 was the band's largest city count to date, running from February 2026 across Sendai, Osaka, Takamatsu, Tokyo, Nagoya, Hiroshima, Chiba, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Niigata in Japan before moving to Bangkok, Hong Kong, Taipei, Shanghai and Seoul. The Taipei Arena shows took place on June 6 and 7, 2026 with tickets from NT$800 to NT$5,880 and have finished. Worth noting for the next cycle: the band ran an official fan-club viewing package for the Taipei and Seoul dates bundling ticket, flight and hotel.
